reviewItems.issue: Non-+08:00 exact deadlines were displayed using their raw offset wall time and edited as +08:00, changing the instant
reviewItems.resolution: Project exact instants into the supported task timezone for display; build edited timestamps in that same timezone; preserve the original instant string when date/time is not edited

reviewItems.issue: After VERSION_CONFLICT, the page had no way to reload the current revision while retaining the draft
reviewItems.resolution: Add a visible '重新读取本地版本' action, refresh only expectedRevision, preserve all draft fields, and require a new user confirmation

coverage: unchanged exact timestamp preserves the original string
editing displayed wall time changes the real instant by exactly one minute
refresh updates expectedRevision without clearing the draft

deviceRegressionAfterFix: pending: Android and HarmonyOS devices were disconnected when this patch was ready
